calculation.description: Contrarian acceleration signal: compares the average 60-day return per 20 days with the recent 20-day return, then scales by annualized 20-day volatility. Higher values identify assets whose recent momentum has decelerated relative to their prior trend and historically predict stronger subsequent 10-day returns. Uses only completed daily prices.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate signal but regime-dependent: annual 10-day IC for the persisted inverted orientation was +0.11184 in 2026, -0.01072 in 2027, +0.04130 in 2028, +0.07092 in 2029, and +0.07836 in 2030 YTD. The 15-instrument cross-section requires conservative interpretation; use as a reversal/defensive ensemble component rather than a standalone allocation rule.

signal_provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; inverted original acceleration orientation; minimum 8 valid instruments
